scalar_object_collision_p13.post_rejection: Both metadata replacements were atomic: zero inconsistencies, no computed definition or grant installed. Admin, reader and no-grant roles retained their existing item and scratch-row roots and the tracked scratch object with id. scalar_object_collision_p13.constellation_approved_difference: Metadata can be accepted; only the ambiguous computed selection is omitted with a computed_field inconsistency. Unrelated roots and grants survive. This differs from Hasura's atomic metadata rejection.
